    ``````markdown
15. Verify that Product stock levels remain unchanged (PROD-001 is still 7, PROD-002 is still 6).

    ## Result Format
    At the end of the test, respond with the following JSON:
    {
        "status": "pass" | "fail",
        "reason": "A detailed explanation of why the test passed or failed."
    }
    ``````

